searchText: Ah you're right! Let me add it ethJS seems to fail with all the clients :/ ``` [el-32-ethereumjs-teku] [02-03|06:57:12] ERROR Error verifying block while running: error: invalid receipttrie (vm hf=prague -> block number=46 hash=0x9f7c5d28df41d1597b073ff577009ddb23e63bc222fbe36ae0349dfab05c6a76 hf=prague basefeepergas=3718291 txs=133 uncles=0) ``` you can modify the above config to add ethJS, maybe reduce the total number of clients so its runs on your machine ``` - el_type: ethereumjs el_image: ethpandaops/ethereumjs:eip7840 ``` I will investigate. We pass EEST tests so not sure what's going wrong here Just to note, EthJS should not be a blocker for devnet-6 EthJS kurtosis failure Wait for me when we get to EOF, I'm on a call till possibly :30 lighthouse genesis check error who is https://dora.pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/validator/70470?v=blocks ? Vouch, they're working on it 😄 edit: its erigon2 Pectra-devnet-6 is live: https://pectra-devnet-6.ethpandaops.io/ Pectra fork is at epoch 10 erigon pairs forked off at epoch 10 (electra activation) in our( prysm) e2e tests for electra, we have an evaluator on validator participation at each epoch. during the first slot of the Electra fork epoch we notice that slot always missed... this is most likely due to the transition of attestation types from pre electra to post electra. wondering if you guys noticed something similar in testing it could also be our evaluator on e2e just just wanted to ask prysm hasnt missed a slot so far in the devnet, even post transition - but perhaps if they build on top of another client the bug isnt triggered? hmm perhaps it's either something with the participation evaluator itself or specific to e2e setups I noticed teku complaining with ``` Failed to decode gossip message on topic /eth2/e551da77/beacon_attestation_27/ssz_snappy, raw message:  java.util.concurrent.CompletionException: tech.pegasys.teku.networking.eth2.gossip.encoding.DecodingException: Failed to decode gossip message ``` for the whole first electra epoch. I suspect some clients send non-singleattestation for that epoch for our e2e setup it's only with prysm clients ( on geth) 🤔 i think the network is like 2 beacon nodes only though will double check with radek on my team to make sure we aren't the ones 😅 attestations EthJS is hit-or-miss? EthJS is slow, but Pari also had problems with the kurtosis (could not reproduce). I'm gonna TAL what's going on Looks like the missed slots we were slightly behind. This is a known issue (having trouble to keep up with tip of chain and the extra tasks such as building blocks)
